$comment: L08 decision 12. A story skips one gate check only with a `gate-skip-<check>` tag AND an entry here: { story, check, rules (axe only: the rule ids it hides), reason (an ADR or issue), expires (YYYY-MM-DD) }. A tag without an entry, an entry without a tag, and an expired entry all fail the gate.
